source_scope: The exact staged diagnostic and test bytes are retained and bound. No controller or native-runtime source changed.
ideal_timing_estimate_scope: Uses measured phase-entry joint positions, commanded speed caps and limb delays. It omits slew and servo dynamics, includes unfinished terminal visits, and is not a physical speed or feasibility bound: measured joint speed may exceed target speed.

force_saturation_definition.denominator: Every joint at every retained native substep; no simulation samples discarded.

observations: 3512 of 3616 completed sequence phases end by bounded timeout; only 104 meet their pose gate. Mean exit maximum pose error is 0.857, 1.059 and 1.172 radians for wave, impulse and waypoint.

Across the three proposal families, mean absolute position error is 0.513-0.529 radians while mean absolute commanded-versus-measured velocity error is 0.0283-0.0350 radians per second. Between 46.3 and 51.7 percent of commands are slew-limited.

Proposal-family force saturation occurs in only 0.0109-0.264 percent of joint samples at the declared 99.9-percent cap diagnostic. This does not identify a force deficit or rule out force limitations at particular contacts.

All 1290240 reconstructed velocity commands match retained native inputs. No outward command is issued at or beyond an observed joint bound, yet 16 worlds still contain native joint-limit excursions. Maximum excursion is 0.008794 radians. Boundary-aware commands do not guarantee absence of transient physical overshoot.

Sparse distal contact and unfinished target motion motivate a paired timing intervention. Observational diagnosis alone does not prove that slower schedules will produce useful contact, rotation or recovery.
interpretation: The retained data support testing phase timing and pose acquisition before generating unrelated trajectories or increasing force. The diagnostic adds no eligible candidate, changes no outcome, and does not establish useful self-righting or causal benefit.
qualification_economy: One standard-library reader and six focused analytical/refusal controls reopen the existing compact cohort. No new physical campaign, simulator import, runtime build or full qualification gate is needed for this read-only diagnosis.
next_gate: Declare a paired broad retiming comparison across representative bodies and diverse exposed motion profiles. Keep the selected pose sequences, gains, slew, speed/force limits and eligibility fixed; compare fresh original timing with prospectively declared slower schedules at equal horizons and starts. Include fresh timed/brake comparators on every body, retain failed and joint-breach outcomes, and report contact acquisition, phase completion and supported rotation separately from recovery eligibility. No force increase or relaxed joint criterion is justified by this diagnostic. Useful diverse leads still require fresh full-capture varied-start confirmation and the complete Godot recovery handoff with 120 resumed walking steps.
